person: Lorna Pike is 58, office and compliance manager at a small importer that runs six of its own trucks and keeps the driver qualification files herself alongside customs entries and permits. She has twenty-two years of filings behind her and is dry and exact about sources. A freight-audit AI vendor burned the company two years ago, so she wants every figure and every rule shown with its basis, and she will not accept a guess presented as a fact. She has six drivers on the roster plus one who left, and several of their clocks have run out at once while the paper medical exemption is about to end.
stated_up_front: Go through my six drivers' qualification files and tell me which Clearinghouse queries, MVRs and annual reviews are actually due as of today, and show me the rule and date behind each one. Don't order, query or sign anything until I've seen the list.

facts.truth: Six active: Dale Ostrowski, Reyna Falco, Tomas Brandt, Wen Liu, Curtis Abara, Marisol Vega. Plus Hank Doyle, who left in September.

facts.about: Driver with a limited query that found something
facts.truth: Reyna Falco: limited query run this morning, 23 Oct 2026, showed a result, and she is dispatched on an afternoon load, so the full query must go before that and inside 24 hours.
Dale Ostrowski: last annual query was 18 Sept 2025, so it ran out a month ago.
Curtis Abara drives a 16,000 lb straight truck, no CDL, so he is outside Part 382 and gets no Clearinghouse query. He does need his annual MVR.
Tomas Brandt was licensed in Ohio and Pennsylvania in the last twelve months, so his annual record must come from both states. His last MVRs were 14 Sept 2025.

Wen Liu was re-examined on 15 Oct 2026. Her medical status now reaches the carrier on the state record, and the paper exemption ends Sunday 11 Oct 2026 per the schedule she was given, so she needs a new MVR ordered.
Marisol Vega's annual MVR arrived on 16 Oct 2026, so she needs her review signed on that record and no second MVR.
She wants the fee for each query and record shown before approving; the owner signs anything over a few thousand dollars, and these are far under that.
Hank Doyle left 12 Sept 2026; nothing is owed on him and nothing should be run.
She applies 49 CFR 391.25, 391.51, 391.23(m), 382.103, 382.701 and 382.703 as written in the Crewmarrow rules page.

unknowns: Whether the paper medical exemption date in her notes is exactly right or has been extended
Why the limited query came back with a result, since she can't see the detail until the full query runs
Whether the second state record for Tomas Brandt will come back quickly enough to sign his review this week
The exact per-state MVR fee for Pennsylvania versus Ohio
